selection_rule: exact_set_accuracy, micro_f1, micro_precision, then earlier candidate
boundaries: This follow-up was designed after observing the first development comparison; it is not a preregistered unseen-data study.
Only train and selection are read. Class balancing uses training labels only.
One frozen encoding per partition is shared across six candidate fits. No encoder updates or threshold search.
Calibration, publisher test, Bitext test, and private reviews remain unused.
No model export or browser promotion. Development selection provides no independent accuracy estimate.
